initial_checkpoint.role: frozen adapted baseline from v1; original source remains unchanged

checkpoint_selection: Validation composite: .25 replay direct raw accuracy +.50 reasoning direct raw accuracy +.25 free-running scaffolded trace final raw accuracy; direct NLL tie-break.
validation_trace_scope: Fixed evenly spread8 validation program groups, all4 variants; predicted past states only.
outer_guard: Stop/select previous eligible checkpoint if old-validation raw accuracy falls>2percentage points or full-vocabulary NLL rises>.10nats.
controller_gate: Genuine TRAIN-only same-activation/equal-continuation-budget positive headroom per candidate after256updates; no teacher-forced trace routing.
final_policy_selection: Validation only among9 decision/candidatepairs and8 thresholds; full-vocabulary gold NLL, ties fewer turns.
new_final_tests: All128test and128OODgroups,4 variants each; oldtest is retention regression, not a fresh discovery set.
success_criteria: Core reasoning improves on fresh held-out data, with raw metrics and free-running steps reported
Outer task retention guard passes and core transformer ablations establish functional relevance
Learned steering improves over the SAME checkpoint disabled; fixed-turn and oracle diagnostics separate static choices from conditional control
continuation_rule: At1024 updates, extension to2048 is allowed only from validation progress and preserved outer ability, before new test performance is inspected.
limitations: Recurrence increases compute without increasing stored weights
Technique bundle does not isolate each training component causally
Scaffolded numeric traces are not unrestricted text generation
